# myCIO

> Senior technology leadership for New Zealand organisations: fractional CIO, technology transformation, AI strategy and delivery, cyber security. Founder-led by Elton McDowall and Michael Nicolle with a senior team behind them. Independent, NZ owned, no reselling. We take technology off your plate so you can get on with growing the business.
